summary: Frontend-only regression on Lux.Sex horoscope + menu restructure + featured article changes. All 7 requested scenarios pass on preview URL. Age gate opens, Horoscope page shows constellation background (agnes-horoscopo-bg.png) and 'Updated by Mestre Agnes' badge, western Áries and chinese Dragão modals load real Agnes API and LLM readings with color/lucky number, personal reading section renders wizard image and Agnes login/members buttons (login href https://frontend-nu-opal-d1fi47s48v.vercel.app/auth target=_blank), header menus expose the exact new items for Turismo/Bem Estar/Vida Noturna/Gastronomia, new routes /turismo/lugares, /vida-noturna/festas, /gastronomia/drinks render BlogPage (200 OK, no ErrorBoundary), partners sidebar swaps in 'Mestre Agnes' card, and featured article on /bem-estar/beleza has clickable image/title/read-more (all point to /bem-estar/beleza/b-1) with PostInteractions share bar; navigating opens the detail article correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BlogPage featured article render is gated on posts.length > 0; empty editorial routes (e.g. turismo/lugares, vida-noturna/festas, gastronomia/drinks, bem-estar/cultura, bem-estar/sexualidade) show 'Matérias em preparação'. That is expected behavior but means the new featured-article-* data-testids are only reachable when Sanity returns posts for the section. Consider seeding at least one mock/demo post per new route so the featured-article CTA is discoverable to users.

AgnesReadingModal cold-start on western signs can take 30-60s (external onrender API). UI does show a loading state; consider adding a subtle 'Consultando Mestre Agnes... isto pode levar alguns segundos' hint after ~5s to reassure users during cold starts.
Personal reading Agnes login button correctly uses target=_blank; ensure rel='noopener noreferrer' is applied (verify in code) for security.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://premium-space-2.preview.emergentagent.com validated end-to-end for this iteration. Featured-article data-testids exist only on editorial subpages that have posts (verified on /bem-estar/beleza -> b-1). Menus in header: Turismo[Lugares,Motéis,Hotéis,Pousadas,Restaurantes,Bares]; Bem Estar[Esportes,Beleza,Cultura,Saúde,Horóscopo,Sexualidade,Contos Eróticos]; Vida Noturna[Locais,Festas,Charutos,Música,Artistas]; Gastronomia[Culinária,Arte,Vinhos,Drinks]. Backend endpoint /api/horoscope/agnes returns valid payloads with color+luckyNumber; western=aries came back with Vermelho/22, chinese=dragao returned Golden Amber/28.
